incident_samples.incident_query: Order service p99 latency spiked from 120ms to 4800ms following release of v2.4.1. Checkout requests are timing out with 504 errors.
incident_samples.expected_root_cause: Misconfigured database connection pool size reduced from 50 to 5 in v2.4.1 deployment config causing connection queuing.
expected_evidence: HikariPool connection timeout after 30000ms
Connection pool utilization at 100% (5/5 connections active)
Deploying release v2.4.1 changelog optimizing pool memory
expected_actions: Roll back order-service to v2.4.0
Increase max_connections in configmap to 50

incident_samples.incident_query: PostgreSQL max_connections limit (500) reached on payment-service database; payment transactions failing with FATAL remaining connection slots reserved.
incident_samples.expected_root_cause: Long-running unindexed query on payment_audit_logs with missing table index holding open uncommitted transactions in idle-in-transaction status.
expected_evidence: Database client pool: 490/500 connections active
FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved
Query on payment_audit_logs in state idle in transaction
expected_actions: Terminate idle-in-transaction connections using pg_terminate_backend
Add index on payment_audit_logs(created_at, merchant_id)

incident_samples.incident_query: auth-service pods terminating repeatedly with ExitCode 137 (OOMKilled) every 45 minutes under standard user traffic.
incident_samples.expected_root_cause: Unbounded in-memory session token revocation cache growing continuously without TTL expiry eviction policy.
expected_evidence: JVM Heap memory reached 92% (471MB / 512MB)
Kubelet cgroup event: Pod exceeded memory limit (512Mi)
SessionRevocationStore contains 1,842,000 entries
expected_actions: Increase pod memory limit as temporary buffer
Deploy patch with bounded cache and 1-hour TTL expiration

incident_samples.incident_query: All authenticated endpoints returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error in auth-service due to InvalidKeySpecException.
incident_samples.expected_root_cause: Automated key rotation job pushed malformed PEM header (missing newline) to Secret Manager breaking signature validation parser.
expected_evidence: Failed to parse RSA public key from secret manager payload
InvalidKeySpecException: encoded key spec not recognized
HTTP POST /api/v1/auth/verify failed with 500
expected_actions: Re-issue previous valid public key JWKS payload
Restart auth-service deployment to invalidate cached key bytes

incident_samples.incident_query: inventory-service Redis cluster returning 'OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory'; cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 8%.
incident_samples.expected_root_cause: Redis maxmemory-policy misconfigured to 'noeviction' instead of LRU eviction, preventing expired key purging.
expected_evidence: Redis memory usage: 15.9GB / 16.0GB (99.3%)
ResponseError: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' policy 'noeviction'
Bypassing cache due to Redis write errors
expected_actions: Execute CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru on Redis cluster
Trigger manual FLUSHDB on non-persistent inventory keys

incident_samples.incident_query: payment-service thread pool saturated with 200/200 threads blocked and incoming transactions queueing indefinitely.

incident_samples.incident_query: PostgreSQL primary node CPU at 100%; analytics aggregation dashboard queries timing out after 300 seconds.

incident_samples.incident_query: api-gateway returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with CircuitBreaker OPEN for user-service while user-service is healthy.
